registered_before: gold labelling, any system run, any adjudication
why: J-1 is burned: the system was developed with sight of J-1's failures (the Demo 0.1 retrieval budget fix came from J1-006; the flagship demo question is J1-009/J1-047's subject). A J-2 question that asks a fact a J-1 question already asked is therefore a weaker test than a fresh one. No question was removed or edited — removing questions after reading them is exactly the tuning §18 forbids. They are STRATIFIED so results can be reported separately, the same treatment §15 gives the demo targets.

author_independence_verified.method: first-hand read of the authoring agent's own tool-call log
author_independence_verified.known_leak: one `find eval/` listed FILENAMES in eval/, which include J1_GOLD.json and J1_INDEPENDENT_QUERIES.json. Contents were never opened. The author learned such files exist, nothing more.
